issues.location: Robinson's National Academy of Sciences distinction
issues.finding: The source calls Robinson the first woman elected to the Academy without qualification. The Academy's own biographical memoir identifies her as the first woman elected to its mathematical section; Florence Sabin was its first woman member decades earlier.
issues.proposed_resolution: Specify the mathematical section of the National Academy of Sciences.

translation_treatment: The Javanese target specifies the Academy's mathematics section. A bounded comparison view records the narrowed claim; frozen English bytes remain unchanged.
